name: Snowflake
description: Developer/data platform: cloud data warehouse with a SQL API and REST APIs for executing SQL and managing account objects.
access_notes: Self-service 30-day free trial account; no permanent free tier. Key-pair JWTs, programmatic access tokens and OAuth integrations are all configurable by the account user/admin without vendor approval.
mcp_notes: Snowflake-managed MCP server is a first-party hosted feature (CREATE MCP SERVER object, OAuth 2.0 auth, serves Cortex Analyst/Search/Agents and SQL execution as tools); Snowflake-Labs also publishes an open-source MCP server. Composio lists a SNOWFLAKE toolkit (own-credentials auth).
uncertainty_notes: Webhooks: Snowflake has notification integrations but outbound webhook support was not verified on an official page, so left null. Key-pair (JWT), OAuth, and programmatic access tokens are all documented for the SQL API and REST APIs; managed MCP server does not support dynamic client registration.

evidence.note: SQL API (REST) authenticates via OAuth, key-pair JWT, or programmatic access tokens, sent as Authorization: Bearer with X-Snowflake-Authorization-Token-Type KEYPAIR_JWT/OAUTH/PROGRAMMATIC_ACCESS_TOKEN.
Snowflake REST APIs support key pair auth, OAuth, programmatic access tokens (PAT), and workload identity federation.
'The Snowflake SQL API is a REST API that you can use to access and update data in a Snowflake database.'
Official 'Snowflake-managed MCP server' docs: first-party hosted MCP with OAuth 2.0, exposing Cortex tools and SQL execution.
Composio toolkit list includes Snowflake (slug SNOWFLAKE) under toolkits requiring your own credentials.
